newsitem.title: CHINA: China's COSCO sues two domestic shipping firms.
newsitem.headline: China's COSCO sues two domestic shipping firms.

text.p: China Ocean Shipping Co (COSCO), the mainland's biggest shipping line, has sued two domestic shipping firms in a dispute over a crew labour contract, the Business Weekly said on Sunday.
COSCO Qingdao Manning Cooperation Ltd brought a suit against Hainan Antaeus Shipping Corp and Qingdao Garland Ship Leasing Co Ltd in July, a court announcement carried in the newspaper said.

The Qingdao Maritime Court in Qingdao in the eastern province of Shandong had seized a vessel, the Rongsheng, to try to force payment by Hainan Antaeus and Qingdao Garland to COSCO Qingdao, the notice said.
It did not specificy the amount owed by the Rongsheng's owners or give details of the size or type of ship.
Because Hainan Antaeus and Qingdao Garland had failed to provide a guarantee for the vessel, the court was putting the ship up for auction at the request of COSCO Qingdao, the notice said.
The ship would be auctioned off on December 18, it added.
The China Ocean Shipping group of companies includes Hong Kong-listed COSCO Pacific Ltd.
